decisions.reason: Door lever handle families are long-lived catalog items for a large German hardware maker and usually stay in the range for many years, though some 2018 launches were already pruned by 2019.
This handle design was still listed in 2019, and design handles typically remain in the catalog well beyond four years, though design lines carry some risk of portfolio pruning.
The L700 LightAccess electronic access system is a differentiated growth product that was rebranded and promoted in 2019, so the firm is likely to keep developing it rather than drop it.
